title: The holidays arrival
description: Celebrate special moments like never before
body:
![Holiday logo.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00e5ee85eb4bfa50f128db170a3a10e1852cbd30.png)

### **Relive those special moments**

The festivities have arrived in your world, and everyone is invited to be part of this celebration with some old friends and some new faces, from terrifying monsters to sweet but dangerous creatures, each holiday is spread across a different biome.

Are you ready? Because festive powers will allow you not only to decorate your house for the occasion, but also to create themed weapons, tools, and powerful turrets so that the festive spirit never fades.

_Available for NeoForge, Fabric coming soon!!_

## _**This mod is still in Beta**_
